Entry Urban Grain Supply of the Crownlands A huge city like King's Landing cannot feed itself off its walls; food must constantly flow in from the Reach, the Riverlands, the Crown's villages, and the sea routes. Royal officials focused on warehousing and rationing, businessmen focused on profits, and hungry citizens only cared about whether they could still afford bread tomorrow. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
